description: Check whether a specific Texas AG opinion has a recorded overruled, modified, affirmed, superseded, or withdrawn status in the AG's own courtesy index. A 'not_listed' result does NOT mean the opinion is still good law -- the AG's index itself says it may be incomplete. Sourced from texasattorneygeneral.gov/opinions/opinions-overruled-modified-affirmed-withdrawn.
name: tx_ag_opinion_status
